requires: a running metal-dash (POST /outputs, GET /venue, POST /graph/node reachable through metal-mcp); the bar venue group heads should have at least two distinct points

expect.step: with the source's tilt stepped from 0 to 1 at t0, every fixture on position k of the group (positions in patch order, one per distinct point) shows the step at t0 + k * 0.25 s; fixtures sharing a position share that time
expect.read: dmx_bus universes: each head's tilt slot equals the lead's tilt k * 0.25 s earlier, k its position index (a 5-head group with all five on one point shows one time for all five)
